title: Lightly Steamed Syrian Lentil Stew
description: A winey and aerated Syrian dish featuring Chinese five spice powder, perfect for a hangover cure, made with mushimono-steam method and vegan-friendly ingredients.
instructions: In a large pot, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Stir in the Chinese five spice powder and cook for 1 minute.
Add the red lentils, tomato paste, red wine, and vegetable broth to the pot.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes.
Season the stew with salt and black pepper to taste.
Transfer the stew to a steamer basket and steam over boiling water for 10 minutes, using the mushimono-steam method.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
